title: SWF: PlaceObject2 with HasMove flag (re-placement)
description: Test that PlaceObject2 with only a new position (no character change) sets HasMove flag (0x10) but NOT HasCharacter (0x02). This is used for motion tweens where a character was already placed and only its transform updates. Verify: (1) HasMove-only PlaceObject2 has flags=0x12 (HasMove|HasMatrix), (2) it does NOT reference a new character ID, (3) a first placement has HasCharacter set, (4) subsequent tween frames use HasMove without HasCharacter.
